response.overview: Jealousy - Demon’s Whisper is a psychological horror short film exploring jealousy, self-doubt, and the destructive nature of comparison. As an inner voice begins to distort the protagonist’s perception of herself and the world around her, ordinary insecurities gradually transform into something darker. The film explores how jealousy can become an internal force that undermines creativity, confidence, and the desire to pursue one’s dreams.
response.tagline: Sometimes the most frightening voice is the one within.
response.title: Jealousy - Demon’s Whisper
